- **vstack-explain** — Produce a concise, source-grounded explanation for a developer, reviewer, or stakeholder from discovery findings
- **vstack-figure-it-out** — Designs a bespoke, auditable playbook when no existing playbook fits or when a task is a large/cross-cutting version of a narrower task
- **vstack-handoff** — Create a complete worker-to-Lead or session-to-session handoff
- **vstack-help** — Select the smallest relevant set of skills

- **vstack-jury** — Coordinate two or three independent reviewers for high-risk work
- **vstack-ledger** — Record important decisions, pivots, failed approaches and evidence references

- **vstack-maintain-verification** — Keep project verification instructions aligned with actual code, commands and behaviour

- **vstack-performance** — Establish a baseline and investigate measured performance issues
- **vstack-plan-loop** — Create, challenge and refine an actionable plan
- **vstack-plan-review** — Independently challenge assumptions, omissions, dependencies and unnecessary steps in a plan
- **vstack-pr** — Prepare a focused, reviewable pull request with evidence
- **vstack-principles** — Core engineering and agent operating rules
- **vstack-prototype** — Build a disposable experiment to resolve empirical or design uncertainty
- **vstack-ready** — Produce a merge-readiness assessment without merging
- **vstack-recall** — Retrieve relevant project knowledge and previous decisions without treating old context as current truth

- **vstack-review-loop** — Obtain fresh-context review and resolve findings
- **vstack-review-rubrics** — Supply reusable review lenses for security, performance, maintainability, accessibility and data integrity
- **vstack-runtime-forensics** — Diagnose live runtime symptoms using available instrumentation
- **vstack-safe-pause** — Leave work in a clean, resumable and non-misleading state

- **vstack-skill-evaluation** — Evaluate skill trigger accuracy, procedure quality, outputs and failure handling through scenario-based testing
- **vstack-swarm** — Fan out N parallel workers for coverage matrices, races, gauntlets, exploration partitions. Returns ONE consolidated report
